description: Cases of reference.json that do not yet match exactly. 'detail': Ruby class and public message prefix match, parser diagnostic text differs. 'pending': a divergence that needs a change outside ukiryu/src/request.rs; the Ruby expectation stays as captured and the test fails once the case matches.

binary-tag.reason: Shared safe_load caller policy (ukiryu::schema::safe_load, Permitted::SYMBOL) reports this YAML tag as Unsupported. Psych result needs a separate shared scalar/tag proposal (not part of the approved YAML-STR-TAG !!str scope); request.rs does not resolve tags itself. Psych yields an ASCII-8BIT String ("hello"); the unified ukiryu::types::Value has no binary/encoding-tagged String, so this also needs a value-model proposal.

bom-prefixed.reason: Psych 5.3.1 (Ruby 4.0.1 x86_64-linux and Ruby 3.4.8 x64-mingw-ucrt) loads a UTF-8 BOM-prefixed request as {'tool' => 'a'} only, so 'command' is reported missing. Yeptris reads all three keys. Reproducing the libyaml BOM behaviour needs an engine/shared-loader decision.

custom-scalar-tag.reason: Shared safe_load caller policy (ukiryu::schema::safe_load, Permitted::SYMBOL) reports this YAML tag as Unsupported. Psych result needs a separate shared scalar/tag proposal (not part of the approved YAML-STR-TAG !!str scope); request.rs does not resolve tags itself. Psych drops the local tag !custom and keeps the String "value".

flow-scalar-continuation-unindented.reason: libyaml accepts a double-quoted scalar continued at column 0 inside a block mapping ('line break'); Yeptris rejects it. Parser acceptance divergence in the pinned engine.

invalid-utf8.reason: Psych::SyntaxError text from libyaml vs the Yeptris diagnostic after 'Invalid YAML in request file: '. Class and public prefix match.
